name: countries-us
description: United States country plugin for claude-for-legal — the retroactively-extracted package that reconstructs today's default (pre-country-architecture) US behavior for Core Verticals via the Provider/Registry system, starting with employment-legal (FLSA overtime, ABC worker-classification test, WARN Act, FMLA/CFRA/PFL/USERRA/ADA leave types). Serves as the reference implementation new country plugins are modeled on.
